name: Regulatory Compliance Review
description: Periodic BaFin-mandated compliance review. Compliance Officer collects evidence; Risk Manager evaluates within 21 days. If risk-evaluation is still open when its P21D escalation timer fires, the flow auto-escalates to a BaFin regulatory notice and closes. Critical findings go to a remediation step. Exercises: HUMAN_TASK escalation timer, DLQ path. Edge e3 carries the constant condition 'true' on purpose: it always wins on normal task completion but is skipped by the escalation-timer path, which follows the single non-conditioned edge timeout-risk-evaluation. The 21-day SLA-breach path and the remediation-unresolved path file distinct BaFin regulatory-notice reasons (sla_breach_30_days on regulatory-auto-escalation via timeout-risk-evaluation; remediation_unresolved on the new node remediation-unresolved-escalation via e10) -- the two inbound meanings of the former shared node are now split into two nodes because edges carry no variable-assignment mechanism. Remediation is a person, not a sub-process (v1.6, ISS-1025 / Q-1007): the node remediation-subprocess (id kept stable; it is a HUMAN_TASK, not a SUB_PROCESS) is assigned to role-compliance-officer, who completes it with output variable remediation_status = resolved | unresolved. Only 'resolved' reaches findings-sign-off (edge e9); 'unresolved', a missing or unrecognised value, or no answer within the P30D deadline (timeout-remediation-subprocess) all end at remediation-unresolved-escalation, never at findings-sign-off. Edge e8 carries the constant condition 'true' for the same reason as e3. Every human task carries a form_schema naming the decision field(s) it must record (v1.7, ISS-1015 / Q-997): evidence_summary, highest_severity, remediation_status, cro_decision, ceo_decision; form_schema is a UI rendering payload only, the fail-closed gateway defaults are the enforcement. Escalation follows D-ESC: timer -> higher role -> fail closed (v1.9, ISS-1013 / Q-995; BA ruling GH #2281). Every human task carries the escalation_timer_duration + escalation_role pair and its normal-completion edge carries the constant condition 'true' so the timer follows the single unconditioned timeout edge. evidence-collection (role-compliance-officer, P7D) times out into evidence-collection-timeout and on to risk-evaluation (role-risk-manager, the next reviewer; escalation_role role-risk-manager). risk-evaluation keeps its P21D -> regulatory-auto-escalation -> end-closed path unchanged. remediation-subprocess keeps P30D -> remediation-unresolved-escalation -> end-closed. findings-sign-off (role-cro, P3D) -> cro-sign-off-timeout -> ceo-override (role-ceo). ceo-override (P3D) is the top of the authority chain (E4): no escalation task, its timeout edge goes straight to reopen-review (more scrutiny), never archive-review. Deviations (documented, no waivers): the BA gave no regulatory durations other than ceo-override P3D and the P21D path, so evidence-collection P7D and findings-sign-off P3D are proposed values pending BA confirmation; ceo-override's escalation_role role-ceo is the co-required CHK-21 attribute only (top of chain). Separation of duties (v1.10, REQ-465 / Q-1028, GH #2323 part 1; REQ-459 rule A): findings-sign-off (role-cro) names evidence-collection, risk-evaluation and remediation-subprocess, and ceo-override (role-ceo) names those three plus findings-sign-off, so the person who collected the evidence, rated the risk or remediated the findings does not also sign them off. ceo-override's findings-sign-off entry is inert on the current graph (findings-sign-off is reached only through its timeout edge, so it cannot complete before ceo-override) and is kept because the graph gives a path from it to ceo-override. Version bumped 1.9 to 1.10 because the separation-of-duties behaviour of the shipped sign-off nodes changed.

evidence_summary.title: Evidence summary
evidence_summary.description: Summary of the evidence collected for this review (what was gathered and where it is filed). Recorded for audit; no gateway reads it. Optional. No personal data beyond what the process needs.

highest_severity.title: Highest finding severity
highest_severity.description: Highest severity among the findings. 'critical' (or no answer) goes to remediation; the others go straight to CRO sign-off.

remediation_status.title: Remediation status
remediation_status.description: Whether the critical findings were remediated. Only 'resolved' reaches CRO sign-off; 'unresolved' (or no answer) files a BaFin regulatory notice.

cro_decision.title: CRO decision
cro_decision.description: CRO decision on the findings: 'sign_off' archives the review, 'reject_and_reopen' reopens it.

ceo_decision.title: CEO decision
ceo_decision.description: CEO decision after the CRO did not respond: 'sign_off' archives the review; 'reject_and_reopen' (or no answer) reopens it.
